summary: Say why a thread Enter or Send queued nothing instead of silently doing nothing

replay.detail: No durable data is replayed; a refused submit queues no thread action, as before.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread authority, fences and mutation rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: When a thread reply, rename or start cannot be queued, the TUI flashes the reason as a yellow warning and keeps the draft: an empty box (Write something first; nothing was sent), an action still being sent, or a thread whose context has not loaded yet.

manual.detail: In fractal tui with thread write access, focus a thread reply box and press Enter with it empty, or press Enter again while a reply is still being sent: the footer says why in yellow and the draft stays.

recovery.detail: Presentation only; no daemon state, pairings or drafts change.
